en.hubeali: Sa’d Bin Abdullah, and Abdullah Bin Ja’far, altogether from Ibrahim Bin Mahziyar, from his brother Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘Abu Abdullah Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> passed away and he<sup>asws</sup> was fifty-six years old in the year one hundred and forty eight (A.H.), and he<sup>asws</sup> lived after Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> for thirty-four years’.
en.sarwar: 7. Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah and ‘Abdallah ibn Ja‘far all have narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother Ali Mahziyar from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ibn Muskan from abu Basir who has said the following. “
Abu ‘Abdallah, Ja‘far ibn Muhammad (a.s.) passed away at the age of fifty bsix in the year one hundred forty eight AH. He lived after abu Ja‘far (a.s.), his father for forty three years.”
